Comfort.Title: Comfort Cookie
Comfort.Description: This cookie remembers your preferences (theme, language) and some of the data you type into tools (for example yesterday's Watch list), so you don't have to re-enter everything on each visit. It also lets you stay logged in longer if you activated the 'Stay logged in' option. Nothing is sent to a third party, nothing is used for advertising tracking — without this cookie, the site remains usable, just without memory from one visit to the next.

EconomyMines.HelpTitle: How does the Mine Report work?
EconomyMines.HelpPurpose: Compute your province's weekly mine report: production, upkeep and miners' salary, ready to share on the forum.
EconomyMines.HelpOverview: Two ways to use this chest: a quick daily report to post on the forum (paste today's text, then click straight on "Format today's report", no calculation, no week to pick), or a priced weekly report (steps below).
EconomyMines.HelpStep1: Pick the week you want to process with the arrows at the top of the page — only days within that specific week will be taken into account, even if your pastes contain others.
EconomyMines.HelpStep2: In the game, open the "Mine management" tab and copy the whole page text, starting from "Maintenance costs increase..." through to the end of the page.
EconomyMines.HelpStep3: Paste that text into the Mines Commissioner's Log. You can paste the interface several times to complete the data for the selected week: each new paste fills in the data already known, without ever erasing anything.
EconomyMines.HelpStep4: Click "Generate weekly report": it computes the production value, upkeep and net (after salary) for the selected week.

EconomyMines.NoDataError: No data recognized. Check that you pasted the game's text correctly.

Cookies.Preamble: This page describes how the officedescoffres.creacube.be site uses cookies and local storage technologies in your browser. It complements the {privacyLink}, which covers personal data associated with your account.

Section1.Title: 1. Reminder: non-official tool
Section1.Content: Office des Coffres is a non-official community tool for the game Renaissance Kingdoms, developed voluntarily. It is neither affiliated with nor endorsed by Celsius Online, the game's publisher.

Section3.Title: 3. What we store in your browser
Section3.Intro: No third-party HTTP cookies are set on this site. We use two browser storage mechanisms, both limited to what is strictly necessary:

Preferences.Title: Local storage — Preferences
Preferences.Purpose: remember your interface choices (dark/light theme, French/English language), your default character, and your last inputs in public tools (Watch, Mines Report).
Preferences.Data: your chosen theme, language, default character ID, cache of texts you have pasted into public tools.
Preferences.Retention: until you clear site data from your browser, or withdraw your consent via the cookies banner.
Preferences.LegalBasis: your consent (GDPR art. 6.1.a, French Data Protection Act art. 82).
Preferences.IfDecline: the site works normally, but your preferences and drafts are not remembered between visits.

Tokens.Title: Local storage — Authentication tokens
Tokens.Purpose: maintain your connection to your user account during your session.
Tokens.Data: an access token (short-lived) and a refresh token (longer-lived if you check "Stay logged in").
Tokens.Retention: access token valid for 15 minutes; refresh token valid for 12 hours by default or 30 days if you checked "Stay logged in".
Tokens.LegalBasis: these tokens are strictly necessary for the service requested (your login). As such, they are exempt from consent under article 82 of the French Data Protection Act, but documented here for transparency.
Tokens.IfDecline: you cannot stay logged in — you would need to re-authenticate on each action, making usage impractical.

Section4.Title: 4. What we don't do
Items: No audience measurement or behavioral analytics cookies (Google Analytics, Matomo, Plausible, etc.).
No data sharing with third-party services for commercial purposes.
No sale of information to anyone.

Section5.Title: 5. Technical note: HTTP cookies vs local storage
Section5.Content: Technically, this site does not use "cookies" in the classic HTTP sense. It uses the browser's localStorage mechanism to store preferences and authentication tokens. This distinction is purely technical — from the perspective of the CNIL and GDPR, both mechanisms fall under the same information and consent obligations, and are treated identically in this policy. The term "cookies" is used in the consent banner for general understanding.

Section6.Title: 6. Distinction between anonymous visitor and registered user
Section6.Anonymous: Anonymous visitor (no account): only the Preferences storage can be enabled, based on your choice in the cookies banner. Nothing else is stored.
Section6.Registered: Registered user with an account: authentication tokens are added to local storage when you log in. Your account data itself (characters, account preferences) is stored on our server, not in your browser — see {privacyLink}.

Section7.Title: 7. Your rights
Section7.Withdraw: Withdraw consent at any time via the "Manage preferences" button in the navigation. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing based on consent before withdrawal.
Section7.Erase: Erase stored data: clearing your site data from your browser (Settings → Privacy → Clear data) instantly removes everything stored on the browser side.
Section7.Complaint: Right to lodge a complaint with the {cnilLink} if you consider that the processing of your data does not comply with GDPR.

Section8.Title: 8. Changes to this policy
Section8.Content: This policy may be modified to reflect technical or regulatory changes. Any substantial modification will be signaled by a re-opening of the consent banner on your next visit. The date of last modification is indicated at the bottom of this page.
